Add someone with a Voidhash account to the organization as a member. They can use its projects at
once. Adding a member again keeps their role.

Someone without an account is invited by email from the dashboard, and making someone an admin is
done there too.

Usage:
  voidhash member invite [email] [flags]

Arguments:
  email  The email of their Voidhash account

Flags:
  -h, --help                 Show help for this command
      --json                 Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --org <org>            Organization to act on: its slug, name or id (default: the organization
                             of this directory's or your default project)
  -q, --quiet                Print only ids, one per line
      --role <admin|member>  Their role: member (the default). Making someone an admin is done in
                             the Voidhash dashboard

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash member invite sam@example.com
  voidhash member invite sam@example.com --org acme
